verdict.rationale: Sprinto's own docs list ISO 27001 among the frameworks it manages, alongside pre-mapped controls and audit-ready reports. Nothing in the pack shows ISO 27001 treated as first-class beyond being named and mapped, which is exactly what the story asks to go beyond. Missing for 10: evidence of the current (2022) Annex A control set, Statement of Applicability generation or management, ISO-specific certification-audit artifacts (e.g. Stage 1/Stage 2 support, ISMS scope documents), and any independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a security engineer, ISO 27001 is a first-class framework — the current Annex A control set, Statement of Applicability, and certification-audit artifacts are supported, not just mapped

citations.quote: One platform, multiple frameworks: Manage SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, HIPAA, PCI-DSS, and others in one place.
Sprinto is a security compliance automation platform designed to help cloud-hosted companies meet and maintain compliance across standards like SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, and more.
Fast-track audits: Automate 80% of manual effort with pre-mapped controls, integrations, and workflows.
